edges.reason: tx.origin is used as the key of _holderLastTransferTimestamp to enforce one purchase per block; origin-based checks are spoofable/phishable.
block.timestamp is compared against _holderFirstBuyTimestamp to decide the early sell tax, creating timestamp dependency.
msg.sender receives the entire minted supply in the constructor.
Chire passes msg.sender as the transferFrom source after self-approving the owner allowance.
_holderLastTransferTimestamp gates transfers using tx.origin and block.number.
_holderFirstBuyTimestamp drives time-based early sell fee branching.
_blacklist is read to block transfers to/from blacklisted addresses.
maxTransactionAmount bounds the transfer amount for AMM trades.
maxWallet bounds the recipient balance.
automatedMarketMakerPairs determines buy/sell classification for fees.
_isExcludedFromFees decides whether fees are taken.
_isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount decides whether limits apply.
limitsInEffect enables the anti-whale block.
tradingActive is required for non-excluded transfers.
transferDelayEnabled enables the per-block transfer delay.
swapTokensAtAmount threshold decides if swapBack runs.
The swapping guard is read and written around swapBack inside _transfer.
_transfer sets swapping true before external calls and false afterwards.
_transfer invokes swapBack which performs external ETH transfers and router calls.
_transfer rewrites sellTotalFees based on the early sell branch.
_transfer rewrites sellMarketingFee based on the early sell branch.
_transfer rewrites sellLiquidityFee based on the early sell branch.
_transfer rewrites sellDevFee based on the early sell branch.
_transfer accumulates tokensForMarketing from the collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForLiquidity from the collected fees.
_transfer accumulates tokensForDev from the collected fees.
_transfer blacklists the recipient during the anti-bot launch window.
_transfer records _holderFirstBuyTimestamp[to] = block.timestamp.
_transfer records _holderLastTransferTimestamp[tx.origin] = block.number.
from parameter is classified against AMM pairs and blacklist.
to parameter is checked for maxWallet and blacklist.
amount parameter is bounded by maxTransactionAmount and used for fee math.
contractTokenBalance decides whether the external swapBack call happens.
fees is computed with SafeMath mul/div and subtracted from amount.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call to devWallet allowing code execution by the recipient.
swapBack performs a low-level ETH call of the full balance to marketingWallet, a reentrancy vector.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth before computing ETH shares.
swapBack calls addLiquidity when liquidity tokens and ETH are available.
contractBalance is read from balanceOf(address(this)) in swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap aggregates the pending fee buckets.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing to zero after distributing ETH.
swapBack uses and resets tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack uses and resets tokensForDev.
swapBack pays the marketingWallet address held in state.
swapBack pays the devWallet address held in state.
swapTokensForEth calls the external router swap function which can transfer tokens and re-enter.
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for path and approval.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
tokenAmount parameter is approved and swapped.
addLiquidity calls the external router addLiquidityETH payable function.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router deadline.
Chire loops over transferFrom pulling tokens from msg.sender under the owner allowance.
recipients array controls who receives tokens in the Chire loop.
values array is multiplied by 10**decimals and transferred.
enableTrading sets tradingActive true; onlyOwner protected.
enableTrading sets swapEnabled true.
enableTrading records launchedAt = block.number.
setEarlySellTax toggles the early sell tax flag; onlyOwner protected.
updateSwapTokensAtAmount writes swapTokensAtAmount within bounds.
newAmount is bounded by totalSupply math before assignment.
updateBuyFees writes buyTotalFees after recomputing the sum.
updateBuyFees writes buyMarketingFee.
updateBuyFees writes buyLiquidityFee.
updateBuyFees writes buyDevFee.
updateSellFees writes sellTotalFees after recomputing the sum.
updateSellFees writes sellMarketingFee.
updateSellFees writes sellLiquidityFee.
updateSellFees writes sellDevFee.
updateSellFees writes earlySellLiquidityFee.
updateSellFees writes earlySellMarketingFee.
updateSellFees writes earlySellDevFee.
blacklistAccount writes the _blacklist mapping; onlyOwner protected.
isBlacklisted parameter is written into _blacklist.
excludeFromFees writes _isExcludedFromFees for an account.
account parameter is used as the exclusion key.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates to the private setter; onlyOwner protected.
pair parameter is validated against uniswapV2Pair before being set.
_setAutomatedMarketMakerPair writes automatedMarketMakerPairs.
updateMarketingWallet changes the address later used in low-level ETH calls.
newMarketingWallet parameter becomes the payment destination.
updateDevWallet changes the address later used in low-level ETH calls.
newWallet parameter becomes the payment destination.
updateMaxTxnAmount writes maxTransactionAmount.
updateMaxWalletAmount writes maxWallet.
removeLimits sets limitsInEffect false permanently.
disableTransferDelay sets transferDelayEnabled false permanently.
updateSwapEnabled toggles swapEnabled.
excludeFromMaxTransaction writes _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount.
constructor mints the total supply to the deployer via msg.sender.
constructor sets the immutable uniswapV2Router.
constructor creates and stores the uniswapV2Pair.
constructor registers the pair as an AMM market maker pair.
constructor excludes owner, contract and dead address from fees.
constructor sums buy fee components into buyTotalFees.
constructor sums sell fee components into sellTotalFees.

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful within it.
to is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful within it.
amount is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful within it.
Local computed balance gating the swapBack call inside _transfer.
Local fee amount derived from transfer amount inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is the swap input parameter of swapTokensForEth.
recipients array drives the transferFrom loop in Chire.
values array drives the transferred amounts in Chire.
contractBalance is the local supply figure processed by swapBack.
totalTokensToSwap is the local aggregation used by swapBack.
newAmount is the bound-checked input written to swapTokensAtAmount.
newMarketingWallet is written to the marketingWallet state used by swapBack.
newWallet is written to the devWallet state used by swapBack.
account is the key written into _isExcludedFromFees.
isBlacklisted is the value written into the _blacklist mapping.
pair is validated and passed to the AMM pair setter.
